title: 21 Lessons for the 21st Century
author: Yuval Noah Harari
summary: Harari looks at present-day issues such as technology, work, nationalism, terrorism and meaning, asking how people can stay sane and free in a fast-changing world.
readIf: you want broad, big-picture essays on where society is headed.
skipIf: you prefer deep dives on a single topic with detailed evidence.
